title.ja: 図1-1 左美濃囲いの基本形
title.en: Figure 1-1: Basic form of the Left Mino castle

explain.ja: 左美濃囲いの基本形は図1-1のようになります。振り飛車で使われる美濃囲いを左右反転させたような形ですが、7七に角があるのが美濃囲いとの違いです。
explain.en: The basic form of Left Mino is as in Figure 1-1. It looks like the Mino castle used in Ranging Rook mirrored left to right, but differs in having the bishop on 7七.

section.en: Basic shape of the Left Mino castle

title.ja: 図1-2 玉を寄って、金を上がる
title.en: Figure 1-2: Move the king over and raise the gold

explain.ja: 左美濃囲いを組むには、まず玉を6八まで寄ってから▲5八金右と金を上げます。この形が「舟囲い」で、これを発展させて左美濃囲いに組みます。ここで▲9六歩と端の歩を突いておく指し方も多いです。
explain.en: To build Left Mino, first shift the king to 6八 and raise the gold with ▲5八金右. This shape is Funagakoi, which is developed into Left Mino. Playing the edge pawn ▲9六歩 here is also common.

section.ja: 左美濃囲いの組み方、手順は?
section.en: How to build the Left Mino castle: the move order

title.ja: 図1-3 角を上がって美濃囲いに
title.en: Figure 1-3: Raise the bishop to make a Mino castle

explain.ja: 玉を8八に移動させるため、まず角を退かします。そこから▲8八玉、▲7八銀と組めば左美濃囲いの完成です。
explain.en: To move the king to 8八, first move the bishop away. Then ▲8八玉 and ▲7八銀 complete Left Mino.

section.ja: 左美濃囲いの組み方、手順は?
section.en: How to build the Left Mino castle: the move order

explain.ja: 天守閣美濃という陣形に組むには、図1-3から角を動かさず、▲8六歩、▲8七玉と玉を上に動かします。この陣形も実戦でよく現れます。左美濃は矢倉に比べて横からの攻めに強く、囲うまでの手数も短いです。縦からの攻めに弱いため主に対振り飛車で使われますが、相居飛車でも使われ、矢倉より短手数で囲え、角のラインが開いて攻めに使えるのが特徴です。右四間飛車や居角左美濃急戦のような攻撃的な戦法と相性がよいです。振り飛車の美濃囲いとの違いは7六に歩があることで、通常の美濃囲いより一層コビン攻めに弱く、角頭を狙われるのが弱点です。
explain.en: To build the Tenshukaku Mino formation, without moving the bishop from Figure 1-3, move the king up with ▲8六歩 and ▲8七玉. This formation also appears often in real games. Compared with Yagura, Left Mino is stronger against lateral attacks and takes fewer moves. Being weak to frontal attacks it is mainly used against Ranging Rook, but it is also used in double Static Rook, where it can be built in fewer moves than Yagura and the bishop's line is open for attack. It suits aggressive strategies such as Right Fourth File Rook and Stationary Bishop Left Mino fast attacks. Unlike Ranging Rook's Mino it has a pawn on 7六, so it is even weaker to the kobin attack and the bishop's head is a weakness.

section.ja: 左美濃囲いの組み方、手順は?
section.en: How to build the Left Mino castle: the move order

explain.ja: スタンダードな「左美濃囲い」です。基本的には対振り飛車で使いますが、右四間飛車左美濃のような居飛車の戦法でも使われます。横からの攻めには強いですが、角頭を攻められるのが弱点です。ここから▲6六歩、▲6七金として高美濃囲いのような陣形に発展させるか、銀冠を目指すのが一般的です。
explain.en: This is the standard Left Mino. It is basically used against Ranging Rook but also in Static Rook strategies such as Right Fourth File Rook with Left Mino. It is strong against lateral attacks but its weakness is an attack on the bishop's head. From here it is common to develop into a Taka-Mino-like shape with ▲6六歩 and ▲6七金, or aim for Ginkanmuri.

explain.ja: 左美濃囲いを発展させたものが「銀冠」で、左美濃の弱点だった角頭を銀でカバーしています。6八の金を6七に置く形もあります。ここからさらに銀冠穴熊に発展させられます。
explain.en: Ginkanmuri develops Left Mino and covers its weakness, the bishop's head, with a silver. The gold on 6八 may also be placed on 6七. From here it can be developed further into Ginkanmuri Anaguma.

explain.ja: 銀冠をさらに発展させると「銀冠穴熊」になります。図からさらに▲8八金とくっつければより堅くなります。左美濃囲いの最終形態とも言えます。
explain.en: Developing Ginkanmuri further gives Ginkanmuri Anaguma. Attaching ▲8八金 makes it even firmer. It can be called the final form of Left Mino.

explain.ja: 左美濃の亜種に「天守閣美濃」があります。玉が一段上がることで、左美濃の弱点であるコビン攻めからあらかじめ逃げた形になります。玉頭が弱いので相居飛車ではまず使われませんが、対振り飛車ではかなり優秀な陣形です。ここから4枚美濃や端玉銀冠に発展させられます。
explain.en: Tenshukaku Mino is a variant of Left Mino. With the king one rank higher, it has pre-emptively escaped the kobin attack that threatens Left Mino. The king's head is weak, so it is rarely used in double Static Rook, but it is a very good formation against Ranging Rook. It can develop into 4-piece Mino or edge-king Ginkanmuri.

explain.ja: 天守閣美濃を発展させ、金銀4枚で守る形が「4枚美濃」です。攻めの銀も守りに使うのでかなり堅くなりますが、その分攻めは細くなります。
explain.en: Developing Tenshukaku Mino and defending with four gold/silver pieces gives the 4-piece Mino. Since the attacking silver is also used in defence it becomes very solid, but the attack becomes thin.

explain.ja: 天守閣美濃から玉を9筋まで移動させた形が「端玉銀冠」で、故・米長邦雄永世棋聖が愛用したため「米長玉」とも呼ばれます。玉に絶対に王手がかからない形なので、終盤の寄せ合いで強いとされます。4枚美濃から発展させて4枚で囲う形もあります。
explain.en: Edge-king Ginkanmuri moves the king from Tenshukaku Mino to the 9th file. The late Kunio Yonenaga favoured it, so it is also called "Yonenaga king". Because the king can never be checked in this form it is considered strong in endgame races. There is also a form developed from the 4-piece Mino with four pieces.

section.en: Edge king with silver crown (Yonenaga king)

title.en: Figure 2-7: Static Rook Left Mino with bishop

explain.ja: 通常の左美濃と異なり、角を8八のまま囲う陣形が「居角左美濃」です。矢倉戦法で使う囲いで、角のラインを活かした速攻を狙います。囲う手数を省略できるうえ、8六の地点が争点になりにくいという利点があります。
explain.en: Unlike ordinary Left Mino, the formation that castles with the bishop left on 8八 is Stationary Bishop Left Mino (居角左美濃). It is used in Yagura openings and aims for a quick attack using the bishop's line. It saves moves, and the 8六 square is less likely to become a point of contention.

explain.ja: 左美濃囲いがそのまま左にずれた囲いが「端美濃囲い」です。名前は美濃ですが、どちらかといえば穴熊に近い囲いで、穴熊より手数が1手省略でき、玉が角のラインに入らない点が利点です。しかし端攻めにはかなり弱く、香車の真上に玉がある形を串に刺さった様子に見立てて「串カツ囲い」とも呼ばれます。実戦で見ることは少ないでしょう。
explain.en: Hashi-Mino is Left Mino shifted one file to the left. Despite the name it is closer to Anaguma, saving one move over Anaguma and keeping the king off the bishop's line. However it is quite weak to edge attacks, and since the king sits directly above the lance it is also called the Kushikatsu castle. It is rarely seen in real games.

section.ja: 端美濃囲い(串カツ囲い)
